answer: Harberger slot tax: every earning identity occupies a slot whose owner self-declares a price and pays 2% of it per epoch. Validators check the tax was paid before counting the slot's work, and anyone may buy a slot at its declared price. A farm splitting into many slots pays tax on each one; a lowball price, like a marble statue tagged for pennies, invites takeover, so cost is unavoidable per identity. Rewards land per slot, so splitting gains nothing. Limit: a rich buyer swooping like a falcon can grab slots, and an honest owner on a basalt-hard budget must keep paying in lean epochs.
